$meta.title: New online job adverts with a Burnley work location, monthly

measures.definition: New online job adverts first seen in the calendar month with a work location assigned to the area (Textkernel), all occupations; a flow of new adverts, not a stock of vacancies
measures.notes_common_to_every_row: no annual totals are given because months are suppressed; official statistics in development

$meta.table: Labour demand volumes by Standard Occupation Classification (SOC 2020), UK, Table 2
$meta.edition: January 2017 to September 2026 edition, released 23 October 2026
$meta.citation: ONS (2026) Labour demand volumes by SOC 2020, UK, 23 October 2026
$meta.vintage: official statistics in development; each edition revises earlier months
$meta.caveat: A flow of new adverts, not a count of vacancies: one job can be advertised more than once. Suppressed months are gaps. Several months since October 2025 are partly imputed by the ONS.
$meta.rules: No person is named. Companies are named only in the largest filers panel, from their own filed accounts. No estimate is shown as fact. Derived figures carry their arithmetic.
